project_title: Mass PDF & Excel Password Unlocker & Manager
archetype: The Performance Pro & Swiss Precision Utility

theme_strategy.description: Tactical dark theme with slate navy surfaces (#0F172A), deep obsidian (#020617), high-contrast data rows, and vibrant signal badges (Emerald for unlocked, Amber for matching, Rose for locked/error, Indigo for matched).

layout_architecture.grid_system: MODE B: High Density Command & File Queue
layout_architecture.top_navbar: Sticky header with app brand logo, active task counter (Files loaded, Unlocked count, Batch status), global actions (Download Unlocked ZIP, Merge PDFs), and Theme Toggle

main_workspace.upper_section: Two-column grid (lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6): Column 1 (span 7) = Drag & Drop File Intake Zone with batch stats; Column 2 (span 5) = Bulk Password List Input Panel (textarea + preset import + quick password tester)
main_workspace.lower_section: Full width File Management Data Table with filtering (All, Locked, Matched, Unlocked, Error), search, batch selection, row actions (Test Password, Unlock, Merge PDF, Replace File, Delete File)

key_features_to_implement: Bulk Upload PDF and Excel (.pdf, .xlsx, .xls, .csv) with Drag & Drop or File Picker
Bulk Password List Input (one per line, comma-separated, or paste) with quick import/save presets
Automatic Password Matching Engine (simulated or client-side batch validation testing each password against protected files)
Password Removal / Unlocking Workflow (converts matched password to permanently unlocked output file)
Bulk Save / Download as ZIP (maintaining exact original file names, extension, and structure)
Individual File Action Controls: Delete file, Replace file with new version, Re-try custom password, Preview status details
PDF Merger Tool (selectable PDFs to merge into a single combined PDF document)
Interactive Batch Operations: Select All, Bulk Delete, Bulk Unlock, Export Report (JSON/CSV)
Real-time progress bars and toast alerts (Sonner) for password matching and file decryption processes

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill or clean rectangular with rounded-lg. High contrast primary CTA with hover scale and micro shadow.
component_guidelines.inputs: Shadcn Textarea and Input customized with JetBrains Mono for password input. Clear active ring state.
component_guidelines.badges: Pill badges with indicator dot (pulse animation on matching in progress).
component_guidelines.tables: Dense, clean border-b table rows with hover highlight (`hover:bg-slate-800/50`). Row selector checkboxes.
component_guidelines.dialogs: Shadcn Dialog for PDF Merger preview/modal and File Replace dialog.

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive element must include data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Create creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use transparent backgrounds without backdrop-blur on headers or modals.
Always use exact data-testid attributes for testing.
Provide clear interactive states (hover, focus, disabled, active) with smooth CSS transitions.
Ensure zero horizontal scroll on default viewports and robust mobile responsive layout.
